featured_reviews.name: Sameeha Akudi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am absolutely flabbergasted and disgusted by how your business has chosen to handle the issue of our missing order amounting to almost £1800.

Let’s start with the basics: it is your job as the vendor to ensure the items we purchase actually reach us. That’s Business 101, in case you missed it. It is not, nor will it ever be, our responsibility to play courier investigator when your chosen delivery service—who, by the way, must be the poster child for incompetence—can’t figure out how to do their job. It’s honestly laughable how much effort it took just to get you to even attempt resolving this. Spoiler alert: you failed miserably.

Despite giving you every opportunity to handle this on our behalf, you repeatedly dropped the ball. But hey, I suppose stellar customer service and basic problem-solving skills are a bit much to expect from a business that, frankly, would struggle to survive in the UK market. I’m sure future customers will be thrilled to hear how your delivery arrangements resulted in our items being left outside our property—without our consent, might I add—only to be stolen. And then you just sat there twiddling your thumbs. Bravo!

Ah, but it gets better. Instead of owning up to your glaring incompetence, you doubled down by accusing us of being thieves. Really? That’s rich coming from a company that forced us into your “free” shipment option and then utterly failed to deliver on it. Your baseless accusations were laughably self-contradicted when you yourself acknowledged that our family traveled to Mumbai to pick up the items. So, which is it? Did we somehow “steal” items we didn’t receive, or are you just throwing darts in the dark at this point?

Oh, and let’s not forget your pièce de résistance—sending us CCTV footage of our family in your store. What exactly was the point of that? Beyond being deeply creepy and downright bizarre, it added absolutely nothing to the discussion. Well done on cementing your place as the most unprofessional retailer we’ve ever dealt with.

Rest assured, I’ll be leaving reviews everywhere to warn others about the farce that is your business. Shopping at your store is less a retail experience and more of a tragic comedy—perfect for anyone looking for frustration, incompetence, and a good laugh at your expense. Bravo, indeed.

I had a wonderful experience at Mangal Royal jewels ! From the moment I walked in, the staff were warm, welcoming, and incredibly knowledgeable. They helped me choose the perfect piece — a beautiful necklace that was even more stunning in person than in the photos.
